about_the_game:
Ascend the mountain, scavenge what you can, and upgrade your gear to push forward. Carve a path through the mountain pass and uncover the truth buried beneath wind, stone, and silence. No timers, no pressure—just you and the mountain. Conquer the terrain, and in doing so, conquer yourself.

Features:

- Solo Exploration: Experience a meditative, pressure-free journey through a mysterious mountain landscape.

- Resourceful Progression: Sell wood for cold, hard cash. Scavenge relics of the past to upgrade your tools and reach new heights.

- Uncover the Truth: Follow the whispers of legend to piece together the fate of Captain Elias and the treasure he died to protect.

- Atmospheric World: Explore a rich, quiet world shaped by time, weather, and forgotten stories.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 470 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: An exploration-focused game set on a remote island said to hide a long-forgotten treasure. Scavenge resources, sell what you find, upgrade your gear, and carve your way through a mysterious forest. Uncover scattered clues, piece together a legend, and conquer the mountain- at your own pace.

English*, Simplified Chinese*
